lines.en: Clicking steps forward
Rumbles with a growl
Shuffles forward
Baring fangs
Chomping rotting wood
Sizzling sound of searching for food
Munching on a rotting corpse
Hunger cry
Moving in the corrupted soil
Chomping on the dirt

lines.zh: 骷髅指节摩着枪管走动
lines.en: Bone knuckles rasp the barrel as it walks
It paces, dragging its night vision module

lines.zh: 我站着不动，是在等主人吹哨。
lines.en: I stand still, waiting for my master's whistle.

lines.zh: 绿光暗了一下，又亮起来。
lines.en: The green light dims, then brightens.
Looking down thoughtfully
Turning its neck

lines.zh: 我下颌张开，又慢慢合上。
lines.en: My jaw opens, then closes slowly.
Shaking its skull

lines.zh: 我在等主人吹一声口哨。
lines.en: I wait for my master's whistle.
Closing its eyes
Gently swaying

lines.zh: 空眼窝里绿光缓缓闪烁
lines.en: Green light pulses slowly in its empty sockets

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，我盯上了。
lines.en: Your scent, I have it now.
Showing its fangs
Opening wide eyes
Creeping closer
Growling loudly
Making a low hiss
Spreading its arms
Diamond-steel bones watch you too.

lines.zh: 空眼窝里的绿光定住了。
lines.en: The green light in my socket goes still.
Diamond steel is set into my bones.

lines.zh: 它把枪口抬向你的方向
lines.en: It raises the muzzle toward you

lines.zh: 骷髅头微微歪着打量你
lines.en: Its skull tilts, measuring you

lines.zh: 绿光在你身上停了一下
lines.en: The green light rests on you a moment
It recognizes the iron in your hand

lines.zh: 我的钻石钢壳，被你敲开了。
lines.en: You cracked my diamond-steel shell.
Bone cracked!
Cut wound hurts.
Severe injury, help!
Wing broken, hurts.
Tentacle broken, hurts.

lines.zh: 子弹打穿了我肩上的钢片。
lines.en: A bullet punches through the steel at my shoulder.
Claw broken, hurts.

lines.zh: 我裂开的骨缝里爬着虫。
lines.en: Insects crawl in the crack of my bone.
Fell down, hurts.

lines.zh: 你面前摆着肉，我能抗拒吗？
lines.en: You have meat. Can I resist?
Come on, eat me!

lines.zh: 我的新朋友，共享美食吧！
lines.en: New friend, share the food!

lines.zh: 你看起来很美味，别犹豫了。
lines.en: You look delicious, no hesitation.
Join me in the feast!
You're not going to eat me?
I'm hungry, give me some food!
Why aren't you closer?
Can you smell it? Meat!
You won't let me starve, right?
Watch out, I'm ramming you!
Knock you down, that's my goal!

lines.zh: 我整个身子撞向你的侧肋。
lines.en: I throw my whole frame into your ribs.
A good push and you'll fall!
Perfect spot, right on target!
Ramming is the most effective attack!
Come on, let me ram you!
A direct ram!
Push, push harder!

lines.zh: 撞倒你，是我唯一的意图！
lines.en: Knock you down, that's my only intent!
Are you suitable for me?
We can be stronger together!

lines.zh: 跟我一起，我们的后代会更强壮！
lines.en: Stay with me, our offspring will be stronger!

lines.zh: 你愿意做我的伴侣吗，我可驯服。
lines.en: Will you be my mate? I am tameable.

lines.zh: 和我在一起，你会很安全！
lines.en: Stay with me, you'll be safe!
We can survive together!

lines.zh: 你愿意被我驯服，一起走？
lines.en: Will you be tamed and walk with me?

lines.zh: 跟我一起，我们能抵御一切！
lines.en: Stay with me, we can withstand anything!
We unite, love forever!

lines.zh: 和我一起，我们是完美搭档！
lines.en: Stay with me, we're a perfect pair!

lines.zh: 听到声音，Viventrum慢慢睁开眼睛，四处张望。
lines.en: Viventrum slowly opens its eyes, looking around at the sound.

lines.zh: 它用锐利的目光盯住了你。
lines.en: It fixes its sharp gaze on you.

lines.zh: 那双空洞的眼眶里闪烁着绿光。
lines.en: Green light flickers in its hollow eye sockets.

lines.zh: 你手中的食物让它起了食欲。
lines.en: The food in your hand stirs its appetite.

lines.zh: 饥渴的它渴望着你的肉。
lines.en: Starving, it longs for your flesh.

lines.zh: 你成了它的猎物，只能祈祷。
lines.en: You are its prey, and you can only pray.

lines.zh: 它的叫声如同地狱的低吟。
lines.en: Its call is a hellish whisper.

lines.zh: 靠近它的区域被寒气包围。
lines.en: The area around it is shrouded in cold.
Its teeth glimmer with cold.

lines.zh: 你手中的东西让它的胃酸分泌。
lines.en: The item in your hand causes its stomach to acidify.

lines.zh: 我的夜视模块，在暗里也不怕。
lines.en: My night-vision module sees through dark.
Its eyes only see you.

lines.zh: 你的动作引起了它的注意。
lines.en: Your movements catch its attention.
I level the gun and hold my breath.

lines.zh: 夜视模块把你看成一片红。
lines.en: My night-vision module paints you red.
Its steps quicken.

lines.zh: 它的眼中燃起了一丝贪婪。
lines.en: Avarice flickers in its eyes.
Its breathing grows heavy.
It is ready, about to act.
Its claws grip the air.

lines.zh: 你被它列进了目标名单
lines.en: You have entered its list of targets

lines.zh: 它端起枪，锁住你的胸口
lines.en: It raises the gun and locks on your chest

lines.zh: 那种气息让它兴奋起来
lines.en: That scent sets it twitching
It takes half a step toward you
It decides to test the gun on you

lines.zh: 驯服我之后，我替你看夜。
lines.en: Tame me, and I'll watch the night for you.
Locking onto your movement.
Locating your position.
You are its focus.

lines.zh: 你躲在墙后，我听见你喘。
lines.en: Hide behind the wall; I hear you breathe.

lines.zh: 夜视模块，已经锁住你的热。
lines.en: My night-vision module has your heat.
Its eyes stare at you.
Its breathing gets closer.
My night vision module is still warm.

lines.zh: 我调整瞄具，跟着你移动。
lines.en: I adjust my sight and follow you.
It adjusts the sight a little
The muzzle tracks you
It waits for you to leave cover
A finger rests on the trigger guard
It has worked out the trajectory
You have shown it your back

lines.zh: 它屏住了不存在的呼吸
lines.en: It holds a breath it does not have
A soft click: it chambers a round

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，你动我一下，死一个！
lines.en: Sssss, move and you die one!

lines.zh: 你敢靠近，我保证你后悔！
lines.en: Get close and you’ll regret it!
I drive my stock into your chest.

lines.zh: 钻石钢的爪，刮过你的甲。
lines.en: Diamond-steel claws scrape your armor.
I’m here, nowhere to run!

lines.zh: 我的骨爪从你肩上刮过。
lines.en: My bone claw scrapes across your shoulder.
Taste death!

lines.zh: 钻石钢的骨头挡住了刀刃。
lines.en: Diamond-steel bone stops your blade.
Tame me and I bring diamond steel.
You can’t escape my claws!
The stock slams into your armor

lines.zh: 它用骨爪撕开你的袖口
lines.en: Bone claws tear open your sleeve

lines.zh: 近距离一枪，震得你耳鸣
lines.en: A point-blank shot leaves your ears ringing
Skull fingers dig into your shoulder
It pins you against the wall
A spent casing drops at your feet

lines.zh: 夜视模块亮了，我看得见。
lines.en: Night vision module on. I can see.
I am the bringer of death!
Nightfall, and I appear!
This is my territory!
Wait, for death is coming!
Night, my time!
I am the shadow in darkness!
I shall guard here!
Darkness is my ally!
This place shall be ruins!

lines.zh: 黄铜味里站起一具骷髅
lines.en: A skeleton rises in a smell of brass
It wakes clutching an old gun
Bone rattles in the armory
It crawls out of a shell crater
My night-vision module burns white.

lines.zh: 我摔在石上，骷髅头歪了。
lines.en: I land on stone and my skull tilts.
Drowned, hurts.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的护甲掀开了一角。
lines.en: The blast peeled a corner off my plating.

lines.zh: 箭卡进我钻石钢的肋骨。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my diamond-steel ribs.

lines.zh: 夜视模块短路了，眼前一片白。
lines.en: My night-vision module shorted, everything is white.

lines.zh: 我肚子里空得只剩骨头。
lines.en: My belly is empty down to the bone.

lines.zh: 缝合的皮肉，被雷烤了一遍。
lines.en: The lightning cooked my stitched hide.
Void hurt.
